RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the August 24, 2004/Bhadrapada 2, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Hike in security deposit for new LPG
connections
*401. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the public sector oil companies such as
Indian Oil Corporation, Bharat Petroleum
and Hindustan Petroleum have stopped
issuing new LPG connections;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the oil
companies have demanded a security deposit
hike of Rs. 250/- for each new connection
after the cost of steel went up from Rs. 17000
per ton to Rs. 28000 per ton ;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what is Government’s reaction
thereto?
 Roof top water harvesting
programmes
*402. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether roof top water harvesting
programmes have been introduced in
Rajasthan and Punjab;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the status of implementation of the
project, district-wise?
 Assistance to panchayats due to flood
†*403. SHRI VIDYA SAGAR
NISHAD: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
several panchayats of Gogri-block of
Khagaria in Bihar have been affected due to
flood; and
(b) what assistance has been provided
by the Central Government to the affected
panchayats so far and the steps being taken
to construct platforms with roofs in the
said panchayats?
 Investor Education and Protection
Fund
*404. SHRIMATI SARLA
MAHESHWARI: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

122
(a) the amount structure of the Investor
Education Fund available with the
Securities and Exchange Board of India
(SEBI);
(b) to what extent SEBI has utilized the
available funds for this purpose; and
(c) whether Government are considering
transferring the Investor Education and
Protection Fund (IEPF) available with the
Department of Company Affairs to the
SEBI?
Rural and urban share in bank
deposits
†*405. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the rural and urban share in bank
deposits, at present;
(b) the amount of loans provided by
banks in rural areas;
(c) whether Government propose to
provide more loans for rural areas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Committee for proper water
management
†*406. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
  JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted a new Committee for suggesting
proper management of water in the country;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when the said Committee is likely to submit
its report;
(c) whether Government had received
suggestions with regard to proper
management of water during the past years
also; and
(d) if so, the action taken thereon?
 Farmer-friendly credit policy
*407. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to bring in a farmer-friendly credit
policy during the current fiscal;
(b) if so, the details of the proposed
scheme;
(c) whether Government would grant
interest-free loans to certain categories of
poor farmers;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what is the action plan of
Government to control suicides by debt-
ridden farmers in the country?
 Limited period open sky policy
*408. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to adopt a limited time (three-
months) open sky policy starting
November 15, 2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the special features of the proposed
policy as against the similar policy
announced during 2003-04?
Recovery of loans
*409. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite being
armed with security laws, bank officials
are not issuing notices to defaulters for not
paying the loans;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

123
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government against such bank officials
during the last three years;
(c) the details of the NPAs outstanding
as on date, bank-wise;
(d) the details of the persons,
companies, organizations etc. indicating
their names, addresses etc. from whom NPA
worth more than Rs. 5 crore is to be
recovered; and
(e) the details of the properties etc.
attached during the last three years to
recover NPA?
 Projects for tourism in Assam
*410. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the number of tourism projects
proposed to be undertaken this year in

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 24, 2004/Bhadrapada 2, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
New international airport at
Ahmedabad
2089. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal for setting up of
a new international airport at Ahmedabad
is under consideration;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government would
have the matter examined by a Committee
of Experts?
 Expansion of air services from A.P.
2090. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has sent
various proposals to the Ministry of Civil
Aviation for introduction/increase in
frequency of flights to various destinations
of the world during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of action taken by
Government on those proposals?
 Withdrawal of tax exemption on
leasing of aircrafts
2091. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment of the possible impact of
withdrawal of tax exemption for companies
leasing new aircrafts;
(b) the details of loss that has to be
borne by the IA and AI on leasing out their
aircrafts to others; and
(c) what would be the implication of
this move in the next five years on IA and
AI?
 Hurdles in privatisation of Delhi and
Mumbai Airports
2092. SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI  KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:

468
(a) whether Mumbai and Delhi Airports
are proposed to be privatised;
(b) if so, the time-frame stipulated
therefor;
(c) whether employee unions or other
interests are causing hurdles in the process
of privatisation of these airports; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and what
alternate ways are being considered for the
development of these airports so as to bring
them at par with the best in the world?
 Shifting of Patna Airport
†2093. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that direct Airbus
facility between Patna and New Delhi is
not available every year from the month of
April to August due to relatively shorter
length of runway at Patna Airport;
(b) if so, the solution thereof and the
action taken by Government so far to solve
this problem; and
(c) whether Government are
considering to shift the airport at Patna to
Bihata or elsewhere as an alternative
measure?
 Pension to retired AI employees
2094. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India
employees, who had retired a decade ago,
are yet to receive their pension;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
 Open sky pact between India and USA
2095. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India and USA are working
out open sky pact;
(b) if so, whether US Asstt. Secretary
for Aviation and International Affairs had
serious discussions with regard to adoption
of an open sky agreement between USA
and India;
(c) whether US carriers are very
interested in India and looking at potential
destination;
(d) whether this requires change of
bilateral agreement that exists between the
two countries governing air services; and
(e) if so, by when an agreement on open
sky pact is likely to be signed?
 Expansion of Mysore Airport
2096. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state the present
status of the proposed expansion/
renovation of the existing Mysore Airport
Project in Karnataka?
 Expansion of low-cost airlines
2097. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the recent expansion of low-cost airlines
offering cheaper travel that is affordable
for Indian public;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

469
(b) whether Government have any plans
to promote the industry by way of policies
and incentives in the light of the above;
(c) if so, the details of such plans;
(d) whether there are additional plans
to upgrade or construct new airports at
major cities across India for the low-cost
airlines to offer their services; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Hyderabad
2098. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR

AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
introduce more IA direct flights from
Hyderabad to Delhi and other metropolitan
cities keeping in view the demands of the
